user.title: How should sessions be found?
user.description: Garmin emails a LiveTrack link each time someone shares an activity. The integration can watch your inbox for those emails, or you can start each session yourself with the `garmin_livetrack.start_tracking` action (from an automation, a script or Developer Tools).

menu_options.manual: Manually, with an action (no email account)

imap.title: IMAP Connection
imap.description: Configure the IMAP server that receives your Garmin LiveTrack notification emails.

data_description.imap_folder: Folder where the Garmin emails arrive, as your mail client shows it: INBOX, or a subfolder such as INBOX/Garmin (INBOX.Garmin on some servers). Gmail labels work by name.

person.title: Add Tracked Person
person.description:
Add the first person to monitor. You can add more later in the integration options.

When sessions come from email, the **full name** must match exactly what appears in the Garmin LiveTrack email body.
The **entity prefix** is used to create entity IDs (e.g. 'john' → sensor.garmin_livetrack_john) and to name the person in actions.

start_tracking.name: Start tracking
start_tracking.description: Starts following a Garmin LiveTrack session for a tracked person, exactly as if its email had just arrived. A session already running for that person is replaced.

person.name: Person
person.description: Entity prefix (e.g. john) or full name of a tracked person.

url.name: LiveTrack link
url.description: Link of the LiveTrack session (livetrack.garmin.com/session/…/token/…), as found in the Garmin email.

stop_tracking.name: Stop tracking
stop_tracking.description: Ends the person's running session as if Garmin had ended it: the sensor goes to finished and garmin_livetrack_activity_ended fires. Does nothing if no session is running.

person.name: Person

invalid_url.message: That is not a Garmin LiveTrack session link (livetrack.garmin.com/session/…/token/…).
